We did it!
I gotta admit, this auction
stuff is pretty fun!\var2:00\\end\

Not half as fun as getting
my hands on the spoils is
going to be. Heh heh.\var2:00\\end\

That was so close I could
taste it! I really thought
we had 'em...\var2:00\\end\

To the victor the spoils,
I suppose. Well, maybe next
time.\var2:00\\end\

Who, me? Not a word.\endPage\\end\So, what do you say we find
ourselves another auction,
or even a quest?\var2:00\\end\

Yeah, sure. But there was
something I wanted to go
looking for first.\var2:00\\end\

Lavenicalia flowers.
I don't really know where to
start looking for them, though.\endPage\\end\See, if you grind up the leaves
and the petals, it's supposed to
make a good medicine.\endPage\\end\Thought I'd make some for Cid.\var2:00\\end\

Lavenicalia flowers?
Doesn't sound familiar.\endPage\\end\But I know how to make another
medicine that might do the trick.
If only we had some pearl moss...\endPage\\end\What day is it?\var2:00\\end\

If the auctions were open today,
that quest should be up by now.\var2:00\\end\

Here's what we'll do,
\varA:00\.\endPage\\end\I'll help you make that
medicine, but you have to
find me some pearls.\var2:00\\end\

I don't believe this!
Your friend needs your help, and
all you can think about is jewelry!\endPage\\end\If that's how you're
going to be, I don't even
-want- your help.\var2:00\\end\

Would you stop talking
for a minute and listen?\endPage\\end\The pearl moss and the pearls are
in the same place. No sense mucking
around for moss and passing up pearls.\var2:00\\end\

I guess if they're right there,
it can't hurt. But still...\var2:00\\end\

That wasn't so
hard, was it?\endPage\\end\Now, the pearlsーand the mossーare
in the Galerria Deep.\endPage\\end\Oh, and we can't just go picking
up pearlsーthey'll lock us away
for poaching.\endPage\\end\So we need to accept a
pearl hunting quest before
we go. Got it?\var2:00\\end\

Good day, sir!
It's a pleasure to have
you with us.\endPage\\end\Pardon me for saying so, sir, but
you look a mite nervous. First time
at the auction house, is it?\var2:00\\end\

Well, there's no hurry.
I'll be happy to explain
the house rules to you.\var2:00\\end\

Where shall we begin?
\defaultOption:20\What are areas?\endOption\What are tokens?\endOption\How do you become area champ?\endOption\I don't need to hear the rules.\endOption\\end\

Clans bid against each other
to gain control of an area.\endPage\\end\If you'll look up, you'll see the
auction board, which lists the areas
up for bid at this auction house.\endPage\\end\To bid for an area not listed,
you'll need to travel to the
auction house for that region.\endPage\\end\But the auction season
doesn't last forever, so you'll
have to hurry!\var2:00\\end\

All bidding is done
with tokens.\endPage\\end\Once you've paid the entry
fee, I'll hand you your tokens
here.\endPage\\end\If you'll glance up, you'll see the
auction board, which displays your
tokens and the areas up for bid.\endPage\\end\A separate auction is held for each
area listed. These auctions are held
one immediately after the other.\endPage\\end\It is, therefore, impossible
to purchase more tokens between
auctions.\endPage\\end\Take care not to use too many
tokens early on, or the later auctions
will become quite difficult!\var2:00\\end\

The clan that wins control of
an area is referred to as that
area's champion, or "champ."\endPage\\end\This carries with it any number
of benefits, but I'm not at liberty
to go into details.\endPage\\end\Once you've become the champ of
an area, you'll just have to pay it
a visit and see for yourself.\endPage\\end\A clan remains area champ until
the next auction season opens.\var2:00\\end\

Are you sure, sir? It's no trouble.
\defaultOption:01\I'm sure.\endOption\Well, it couldn't hurt.\endOption\\end\

Enough talk, then.
One never knows until one
tries, as they say.\var2:00\\end\

You can now view the current area champs by
selecting Clan Territory from the Clan Menu.\var2:00\\end\

Ack! I completely forgot
to get that instrument made!\endPage\\end\I'll have to remember to
do that next time I'm near
a shop.\var2:00\\end\

Oops! The instrument!
It was all ready to go
and I forgot to buy it...\endPage\\end\Next time, no forgetting!\var2:00\\end\

Good day.\endPage\\end\I'm afraid our selection
isn't very good at the moment.\endPage\\end\Still, we might have something
you'd like, if you'd care to take
a look.\var2:00\\end\

I can't help but notice
you have some loot on you.\endPage\\end\If you'd like, I can put your
loot up on the bazaar and see what
I can get for it in return.\var2:00\\end\

Loot can be almost anything,
from a rat pelt to a precious gem.\endPage\\end\Hunters and clans usually come
into a fair bit of loot while
questing.\var2:00\\end\

So that's what all that
stuff we've been finding is.\endPage\\end\Meaning this lump of metal
here...is a piece of loot?\var2:00\\end\

That's a piece of loot
if ever there was one.\endPage\\end\Since you seem a bit...confused
about all of this, perhaps a more
detailed explanation would help?\var2:00\\end\

You see, traders at the bazaar
are always interested in acquiring
new, exotic pieces of loot.\endPage\\end\The better the loot, the better the
item they'll give in return.\endPage\\end\Just tell me when you have some
loot you'd like to put on the bazaar,
and I'll take care of the rest.\endPage\\end\I'll add any items I can get from
the bazaar to the stock of items you
can purchase here at the shop.\var2:00\\end\

All right, I'll give it
a try!\var2:00\\end\

I've a new item
in stock now.\endPage\\end\Next time you feel
like making a purchase,
take a look!\var2:00\\end\

We carry all manner of
weapons and armor.\endPage\\end\You seem rather new to all this,
so perhaps I should tell you a
little about the equipment we sell.\var2:00\\end\

Some pieces of equipment
bestow new abilities on their
wearer.\endPage\\end\With these pieces equipped,
you can use the abilities, whether
you've seen them before or not.\var2:00\\end\

There's no better way to give
a new ability a try before
deciding whether to learn it.\endPage\\end\Of course, you'll need a variety
of equipment, and that's where we
come in. *chuckle*\var2:00\\end\

I'll tell you what
I'll do.\endPage\\end\I'm going to write up a
summary of our discussion
about the bazaar and equipment.\endPage\\end\I'll post it on the pub's
rumor board so you can read
it whenever you like.\endPage\\end\Not much of a rumor, really,
but it might be helpful.\endPage\\end\I hope we'll see you
again soon!\var2:00\\end\

\varE:00\Kupo!
You have the instrument
I wanted! Thank you!\var2:00\\end\

No problem!
Just seeing how happy you
are is thanks enough for me.\var2:00\\end\

Actually, there was one
thing I wanted to ask youーif
you don't mind.\var2:00\\end\

You've seen a lot of people...
been to a lot of places,
right?\endPage\\end\Well, there's this place I'm
trying to find. It's covered in a really
thick fogーMist, I guess.\endPage\\end\It's all rockーnothing living.
It feels like it's underground,
but you can't see the ceiling.\endPage\\end\For some reason, it makes me
think of a graveyard. You ever
heard of any place like that?\var2:00\\end\

\varE:01\You seem to know a lot
about it! Are you sure don't
know where it is?\var2:00\\end\

No, wellーthe thing is,
I saw it in a dream.\endPage\\end\For all I know it
doesn't even exist.
But it was so real.\var2:00\\end\

\varE:03\I've never been anywhere
like that before. Sorry
I can't help, kupo.\var2:00\\end\

Nah, it's okay.
I'm sorry for asking such
a stupid question.\endPage\\end\Anyway, I can't wait to
hear you play again.\endPage\\end\That last thing you played
for us was great!\var2:00\\end\

\varE:02\It's not every day you
meet someone looking for a place
from their dreams, kupo.\endPage\\end\\varE:01\I bet you have all sorts
of interesting stories just
waiting to be told!\endPage\\end\\varE:00\As it happens, I don't just sing
songs. I write them, too!\endPage\\end\\varE:01\There's nothing like hearing
about exciting adventures to
set the quill scribbling, kupo!\var2:00\\end\

You came to the right person,
that's for sure.\endPage\\end\I don't know anyone else who
came to Ivalice from another world
through a magick book.\var2:00\\end\

Yeah... That's why I'm doing
quests and looking for adventure.
To get back to my own world.\var2:00\\end\

\varE:03\Do you suppose
I might ask you a favor?\endPage\\end\\varE:01\Could I travel with you?
Kupo?\endPage\\end\\varE:02\I've decided I want -you-
to be the subject of my
next song!\var2:00\\end\

\varE:00\I'm small, I won't
get in the way!\endPage\\end\\varE:02\And you may not know it
to look at me, but I'm not
a half-bad fighter, kupo!\var2:00\\end\

We've never been a clan
to turn people away.\var2:00\\end\

\varE:00\Thank you, kupo!
You won't regret it!
My name's Hurdy.\var2:00\\end\

I'm \varA:00\.
And this is Cid,
and Adelle.\var2:00\\end\

Oh, there's word from
the appraiser about the
stone, \varA:00\.\var2:00\\end\

I was wondering when
they'd be done.\endPage\\end\Guess we're off to Moorabella
to pick it up then.\var2:00\\end\

He's always running off
somewhere. You get used
to it, though.\var2:00\\end\

\varE:02\That's perfect!
Just what I need!\endPage\\end\\varE:00\Something tells me this
song is going to be epic!
Kupo-po!\var2:00\\end\

I was wondering when
they'd be done.\endPage\\end\Guess I'll head over to
the appraiser and pick it
up.\var2:00\\end\

So you really do find
work in pubs...\endPage\\end\I always pictured a pub
as someplace to kick back
and grab a snack.\var2:00\\end\

What better place? People gather
to share a meal, and where there
are people, there's talk.\endPage\\end\Clans pay good money for the sort
of talk that leads to workーthe quests
I mentioned before.\var2:00\\end\

So if we need to make money
or find something to do,
the pub is the place to go.\var2:00\\end\

That's right.
We have a new member in
need of training.\var2:00\\end\

Talk to the barman,
\varA:00\.
Find us a good quest.\endPage\\end\The best way to learn
is to do, lad.\var2:00\\end\

So you're Cid's new recruit?\endPage\\end\Well, if you're looking for a quest,
the first thing you'll want to do
is ask to see the quest roster.\endPage\\end\The roster lists all the quests
on record at the pub.\endPage\\end\Once you've found a quest that
catches your eye, simply pay the
finder's fee and you're done.\endPage\\end\It's not enough to read the quest and
go running off. If you haven't paid
the fee, you'll be on a fool's errand.\var2:00\\end\

Now some quests you can take as long
as you please to finish. Others you'll
have a set number of days to do it in.\endPage\\end\It's all there on the quest roster,
so just pay close attention and you'll
avoid any unpleasant surprises.\endPage\\end\That's all there is to it.
Ready to have a go?\var2:00\\end\

Select "Quest Roster" to see a list of available
quests.\var2:00\\end\

I got us a quest.
"A Paw Full of Feathers".\endPage\\end\They want us to chase
off some wolves.\var2:00\\end\

Let's see...
That ranch isn't far
from the village.\endPage\\end\No hurry, though.
There's no deadline
written on the bill.\var2:00\\end\

Sounds like they're in a
tight spot. I don't wanna
keep 'em waiting.\endPage\\end\I'll go get the others!\var2:00\\end\

See that you're ready before
you go running off!\var2:00\\end\

That boy needs to get his
priorities straight.\endPage\\end\At this rate he's like to
stay here forever.\var2:00\\end\

It's so nice to be
on my own again.\var2:00\\end\

No worrying about anyone but
myself...and no sharing treasure!\endPage\\end\I forgot how good a
little solitude could be.\var2:00\\end\

And what's wrong with that?\endPage\\end\I'm a woman of many gifts.
There's nothing I can't handle!\var2:00\\end\

Indeed, you are most gifted.
Gifts which have lain dormant
for far too long.\var2:00\\end\

Welcome to the Fluorgis
aerodrome.\endPage\\end\We're pleased to offer
skyferry service to the
city of Moorabella.\var2:00\\end\

Welcome to the Moorabella
aerodrome.\endPage\\end\We're pleased to offer
skyferry service to the
city of Fluorgis.\var2:00\\end\

Passage to Moorabella for you and
your companions will be \varA:13\ gilー
return fare not included.\endPage\\end\Would you like to purchase a ticket?
\defaultOption:01\Yes\endOption\No\endOption\\end\

Thank you, sir.
Please take your ticket to the gate.
The skyferry will be leaving soon.\var2:00\\end\

I'm sorry, but you don't
seem to have enough gil.\var2:00\\end\

Welcome to Moorabella, city
of scholars. I hope your journey
was a pleasant one.\endPage\\end\It's quite cold out, so take care
to bundle up before venturing far.
Enjoy your stay!\var2:00\\end\

Welcome to Fluorgis, the city
of fountains. I trust you had
a pleasant journey.\endPage\\end\If your plans lead you
outside the city, do mind
the heat!\var2:00\\end\

I hope we'll see
you again soon!\var2:00\\end\

If you change your mind,
I'll be more than happy to
assist you. Good day.\var2:00\\end\

Passage to Fluorgis for you and
your companions will be \varA:13\ gilー
return fare not included.\endPage\\end\Would you like to purchase a ticket?
\defaultOption:01\Yes\endOption\No\endOption\\end\

\varA:00\, was it?
Ah, yes, here we are.\endPage\\end\The raffle ship delivered
your prize.\endPage\\end\To claim your prize, you'll
need to pay the entry fee.
\varA:13\ gil, all together.\var2:00\\end\

A prize, eh?
\defaultOption:01\Can't say no to that!\endOption\Maybe next time.\endOption\\end\

Very good.
Here you are.\endPage\\end\Do come again soon!\var2:00\\end\

If you decide you'd like
to take delivery, we'll be
holding your prize for you.\endPage\\end\Just speak with me or any
member of our staff.\var2:00\\end\

If you've come to book passage
on the skyferry, you'll need to
make other arrangements.\endPage\\end\All of the ships traveling
to Fluorgis have been grounded,
I'm afraid.\endPage\\end\I don't know when service
will resume, but it shouldn't
be long.\var2:00\\end\

So that's all there is
to it, huh? I had myself all
worked up for...well, more.\var2:00\\end\

The skyferry between Moorabella and
Fluorgis is just that: a ferry, not
much else.\endPage\\end\The cities aren't all that far
apartーhundreds of people travel
between them every day.\var2:00\\end\

Booking a longer trip takes
much more workーnot to mention
money.\var2:00\\end\

Guess ya learn something
every day.\var2:00\\end\

Looks like I got here
just in time.\var2:00\\end\

Are you sure you should
be up and about so soon?\var2:00\\end\

I'm fit as I've ever been, thanks
to the two of you. The doctor's even
given me a clean bill of health.\var2:00\\end\

I was afraid you'd already
left for Fluorgis.\endPage\\end\But then I heard about this
business with the airships and
thought I might find you here.\endPage\\end\So here I am.\var2:00\\end\

Even if I'd missed you,
Moorabella's as good a place
to wait as any.\var2:00\\end\

Well, your guess sure
paid off!\var2:00\\end\

This is great!\endPage\\end\With all of us here
this'll be twice the fun!\var2:00\\end\

Well, let's hear it.
What did you think
of the airship?\var2:00\\end\

It was incredible!
Feeling the wind on your face,
seeing the ocean way down below...\var2:00\\end\

It's the best time
I've ever had!\var2:00\\end\

I suppose we head for the
fens next, then. That's where
these sky pirates said to go, yes?\var2:00\\end\

Yeah. Tramdine Fens.
They said we'd find some
sort of treasure there.\var2:00\\end\

-If- they can be trusted.\endPage\\end\I wouldn't be the least bit
surprised if all we come back
with is muddy boots.\var2:00\\end\

I don't know why, but I
believe 'em. Either way,
we'll find out soon enough.\endPage\\end\But first I wanna take a
look around town and get
ready before we head out.\var2:00\\end\

Now, what is there to
see in Fluorgis...?\var2:00\\end\

I know! We should have some roasted
zignuts and a cup of nua teaーit's
supposed to be great here.\var2:00\\end\

Oh, and I want to stop by the
Anne Salier store. It's affiliated
with Galmia Pepe, you know.\endPage\\end\Don't worry, I only want a little
peek.\var2:00\\end\

She sure didn't waste
any time.\var2:00\\end\

She'll waste plenty of
ours before this is over,
you mark my words.\var2:00\\end\

Have you come to take part
in the raffle?\var2:00\\end\

The drawing can only be
held when there are enough
participants.\endPage\\end\Oh, and there's a small
entry fee, payable when
you claim your prize.\endPage\\end\Would you like me to
see if there's anyone
waiting to enter?\var2:00\\end\

A raffle, huh?
\defaultOption:01\\sprite:0A\ Sure, I'll enter!\endOption\Maybe some other time.\endOption\\end\

You're in luck!\endPage\\end\I've made contact with the
raffle ship, and there are enough
participants to start.\endPage\\end\I'll have your raffle ticket
ready in just a moment.\var2:00\\end\

Thank you for waiting.
Here's you ticket.\var2:00\\end\

I'm sorry, but I wasn't
able to contact any interested
parties.\endPage\\end\Perhaps if you try again
some other time.\var2:00\\end\

If you change your mind,
I'll be more than happy to
assist you. Good day.\var2:00\\end\

I'll hold your prize
for you here as soon as
it arrives.\endPage\\end\Just present your raffle
ticket and have some gil on
hand to cover the entry fee.\endPage\\end\Good luck!\var2:00\\end\

I'm terribly sorry, but there's
been some trouble processing your
raffle ticket.\endPage\\end\Please try again later.\var2:00\\end\

been some trouble processing your
raffle ticket.\endPage\\end\Please try again later.\var2:00\\end\

Whew... How did
I get so tired?\endPage\\end\Maybe I need
a little rest.\var2:00\\end\

That's just what I needed.
Now back to it!\var2:00\\end\

Hmm, how tired am I?
\defaultOption:20\Just a little.\endOption\Pretty tired.\endOption\Exhausted!\endOption\Aw, forget the whole thing.\endOption\\end\

Summer vacation's so close
I can taste it.\endPage\\end\I'm out that door as soon as
the teacher stops talking.\var2:00\\end\

Summer homework: keep a journal.
That's not too bad.\endPage\\end\Better write my name on my
notebook before I forget.\var2:00\\end\

Don't get me wrong, I'm not crazy about
homework. Just, it could be worse.\endPage\\end\And I can already guess what my
first entry's going to be:\endPage\\end\"Summer Vacation, Day 1: Aunt chewed
me out. Grounded for a week."\var2:00\\end\

Maybe this journal thing's not
such a great idea after all.\endPage\\end\Oh, we got another assignment, due
today: "My Summer Vacation."\endPage\\end\We're supposed to write our goals for
the summer. Well, here goes...\var2:00\\end\

Heh, that all sounds pretty convincing.
Summer vacation, here I come!\var2:00\\end\

...Not that I have any idea
what I'm doing this summer.\var2:00\\end\

But, I guess not having any
expectations isn't all bad.\var2:00\\end\

I mean, whatever ends up happening,
it'll be a surprise!\var2:00\\end\

The most populous race in Ivalice,
there are few places where humes
have not made their mark.
A well-rounded race, humes are
equally suited to swordplay and
magery.\var2:00\\end\

Scales cover the bodies of this
reptilian race. Muscled and
powerful, bangaa are physically
imposing. Their rough, bellicose
temperament leads them to pursue
warrior-like jobs.\var2:00\\end\

With a doglike face and ears
that drag along the ground,
there's no mistaking a nu mou.
Extremely intelligent, they make
for powerful mages, but their frail
bodies are ill-suited for physical
combat.\var2:00\\end\

Members of this tall race with
hair of spun silver are often
called the People of the Wood.
Viera are lithe of limb and
tremendously quick. Their slender
bodies belie superior strength and
masterful combat skill.\var2:00\\end\

A fluffy pom-pom and bat-like
wings set this race apart.
Their small stature lends itself to
leaping out and surprising people,
in which they take great delight.
With tiny, nimble hands, moogles
excel at a number of unusual jobs.\var2:00\\end\

A portly, porcine race with
stubby legs, one would not
expect seeq to be quick, yet few
can match their speed. Though
dim-witted and unscrupulous, their
knowledge of battle is formidable.\var2:00\\end\

Wings of a dragon and a powerful
tail distinguish this unique race.
Outwardly small, some might even
say cute, gria make vicious foes
in battle. They have a fierce,
competitive spirit.\var2:00\\end\

Using the area map, you may travel
from one location to the next.\endPage\\end\A blue balloon over a location
indicates your next destination.\endPage\\end\First, try going to Wood Village,
marked with a balloon on your map.\var2:00\\end\

Towns are convenient places to
prepare for your adventures.\endPage\\end\Select a town and press \sprite:04\ to see
a menu of that town's facilities.\endPage\\end\First, try going to the pub, where
you can undertake quests.\var2:00\\end\

Not you, \varA:00\
Clemens!\endPage\\end\Sorry, but your vacation
doesn't start quite yet.\endPage\\end\Your friends are going home,
but you're going straight to
the library, young man.\var2:00\\end\

Let's take a trip down
memory lane...to this
morning!\endPage\\end\When you were late to my
class for theーhow many
times is it now?\var2:00\\end\

That would be...
I don't know.\var2:00\\end\

Enough times that you've
forgotten, apparently!\endPage\\end\\varA:00\...
You're not a bad student
by any means.\endPage\\end\But, occasionally, you
require a little...
correction, shall we say.\var2:00\\end\

Which is why, I have decided
to put you in charge of
cleaning up the library.\endPage\\end\Maybe a little straightening
up there will help straighten
you out, too.\var2:00\\end\

Look, I see what you're trying
to do here. But the last day of
school? You gotta be kidding!\endPage\\end\I mean, it's summer vacation!\var2:00\\end\

Vacations are to be earned.
And you've got a lot of earning
to do, my boy.\endPage\\end\Mr. Randell's down in the library.
Don't keep him waiting.\var2:00\\end\

And don't even think about
loafing off or sneaking out.\endPage\\end\Not unless you want me to
pay a visit to your house.\var2:00\\end\

...Yes, Mr. Blair.\endPage\\end\Well, see ya! Oh, and I hope
you have a really, really great
summer vacation.\var2:00\\end\

Huh?
I thought Mr. Randell
was supposed to be here.\var2:00\\end\

Check out that book!
It looks older than Mr. Blair!\var2:00\\end\

Wonder what it's about?
The pictures are pretty cool.
Swords...wizards...\var2:00\\end\

Huh?\endPage\\end\That's funny. The book just
stops halfway through.
The pages are all blank!\var2:00\\end\

Let's see what the last page
with writing on it says...\endPage\\end\"One is fated to fill these barren
pages. Know you his name?"\var2:00\\end\

"Know you his name"...? What's
with all the backwards words?\var2:00\\end\

Well, I never pass up a chance
to write in a library book!\var2:00\\end\

I'll tell you his name!
"His name is..."\endPage\\end\..."\varA:00\ Clemens!"\var2:00\\end\

Oi, oi.
What have we here?\var2:00\\end\

Why is it always the vicious ones
that pay the worst?\endPage\\end\250 gil is barely enough to
pay for our time sweeping up
the feathers when we're done.\var2:00\\end\

What, you hungry? Sorry, but
I've got higher aspirations
than becoming chicken feed.\var2:00\\end\

Ack!
Who are you!? You're
n-not even human!\var2:00\\end\

Calm yourself, stranger.
We'll protect you, if you'll
let us.\endPage\\end\Join our clan now if you
care to live. I hardly need
spell out the alternative.\var2:00\\end\

Our clan.
You may be injured, but if you
are in our clan, you will not die.\var2:00\\end\

In the dark and distant past, the winding reaches
of the Neslowe Passage were once used as a
shipping lane for goods going to and from the
Clockwork City of Goug.

Countless shafts crisscross the passage depths,
yet no map exists that captures their intricacies,
and several unknown ways are said to exist.

There are rumors of a great treasure sleeping in
one of those darkened corridors, yet many who
have gone in search of it have never been seen
again. Gallant gold-seekers be warned!\end\

A man it was, but with a power no man has ever
known. Thus was it despised and reviled.

Losing hope in both foolish men and its own
cursed self, it became that which they had dreamt
for it: a beast, heartless killer of men, its doom to
walk under welkin in Aisenfield for eternity.
 ーFrom "Dielson's Lay"\end\

Is it just me, or are there more monsters in
Tramdine Fens now than ever before?

The shrine to the Paling Gods there should keep
those things at bay, at least during the daylight

In Tramdine Fens sits a shrine to the Paling Gods,
yet in fact it honors not those protector spirits
of myth, but a small girl who once lived in a
village near the fens. The girl's name was Elpe.
Elpe was said to possess wondrous powers with
which she mended the ill, and drove off all manner
of fell creatures.

Once, a great horde of demons most foul
descended upon her village, and so Elpe
bestowed her own strength upon three standing
pillars of stone, sacrificing herself to keep the
demons at bay.

Since that day, the stones have been known as
the Shrine of the Paling Gods, and not a day goes
by that the descendents of those villagers do
not bring fresh flowers there in rememberance
of their savior.
  ーExcerpt from "The Traditions of Ivalice"\end\

sure, but it's my hunch that hole leads to another
mine shaft...perhaps a forgotten one? Perhaps the
very one that contains the rumored treasure?\end\

Moorabella region guild, the Arbiters of Death,

ice of a Fluorgis merchant manse and said manse's

Oh, kupo! Have you heard? A giant plant thing is

Kupo-po...

Strange things are afoot! When I heard a sieable
number of Fluorgis's fairer residents were off to
Sant D'alsa Bluff en masse, well, I thought that
the end had come at last.

Imagine my surprise when I discovered that they
were not abandoning our fine city, but instead
flocking to a particular house in the Bluff where
the five moogles known as the Moogle Rangers
have taken up residence...in the garden.

While the Moogle Rangers have not been known to
partake in violent acts, reports have shown that
they do nothing to discourage the considerable
donations of gil, jewelry, and consumables given
them by their smitten fans.

Some Moogle Ranger enthusiasts have raided
family fortunes, and even sunk to thievery to
fund their worship of these diminutive giants.

Others have been attacked by monsters en
route to see the rangers, causing problems of
a different sort.

Meanwhile, the fab five are heedless to calls of
"enough," or, indeed, the three eviction notices
already served them.

With the situation coming to a head, we can only
conclude that the Moogle Rangers' intent is
malicious, and a mark request has already been
issued for their pernicious pom-poms.
 Dolowat, Chief Director, Fluorgis Assembly\end\

Listen now to this tale of a time long past.

It so happened that once upon a time, a great
horde of creatures descended upon the peaceful
people of Jylland.

The creatures sought to make a land for
themselves and so they leveled forests, dirtied
waters, and took the lives of countless men and
animals.

Then, one day, a piercing sound rolled across the
land, and a blinding light came down from the
heavens above.

The light burned the creatures where they
stood, leaving naught but ash behind.

When the sound and light had faded, three great
dragons were seen wheeling high in the sky
overhead, surveying the land below.

When they saw that none of the creatures
remained, off they flew to the Aldanna Range,
never to be seen in the skies again.

The people gave thanks to these three dragons,
worshipping them as protector spirits sent by
the gods themselves.\end\

Whispers 'neath the eaves! Three dragons have
reared their fearsome heads in the vicinity of
the Aldanna Range, and they're attacking town
and traveler alike! Such lack of subtlety is sure
to earn them mark status shortly.

Mention of three dragons in the Aldannas might
recall stories of the protector dragons of old,
yet the only similarity here is their number.

These are base, feral creatures with naught but
menace on their minds.

Perhaps the thick Mist of the region is what drove
these typically reclusive wyrms to violence??
 ーDomis Streetears\end\

A portion of a document apparently pertaining to
the development of an unmanned magick weapon
has been discovered, and here printed for the
edification of all.

----------------------------------------
ーPlumfrostー
Plans for the Design of the XII Obtained.
I shall Assay to, with these Plans as a Base,
Create a Weapon far more Powerful than the XII.

ーSkyfrostー
Development proceeds smoothly, thanks in no Small
Part to my possession of the XII plans.

The groundwork for the XII is almost Complete.
Intrigued by its Mist Absorption Functions, I have
Contrived means to convert this Mist, typically
used for Growth, into a Weapon. This shall then
serve as the Main Cannon.

ーGreenfireー
Considering other Options for the Mist Absorption
Growth Mechanism, so that it need not rely solely
upon Mist for its Working. If other Materials could
be used for Growth, said Growth would proceed at
a phenomenal Rate.

After testing many Substances, I found those
occurring in Nature to be most promising: Molten
Rock, Snow, Sea Water, &c.

ーBloodfireー
The Growth feature has been significantly
Expanded! I have succeeded in drawing sufficient
Energies for Growth from Molten Rock.

Tests have been highly encouraging, showing
no less than a tenfold Improvement over the
performance data of the original XII.

I must admit, not even I expected Progress on
such a superlative Scale!

In giving Consideration to future use in the Field,
I have taken Steps to camouflage the Weapon by
painting it Red in its Entirety.\end\

ーRosefireー
Of late, my "Superiors" (so are They called, 
though not by Me in my Privacy) have seen fit
to Sniff and Scrabble at my Laboratory Door like
so many Bloodhounds.

I fear what would become of my Research
should these Hounds espy the Fox. 

In Anticipation of such a misfortunate Event,
I have wisely created a Duplicate Model.
Since I used as a Base an unmanned Magickal
Weapon which I had fashioned prior to coming
into possession of the XII Plans, it was by
Comparison swift to complete.

In designing this second Unit, I sought to further
expand its Potential for growth fueled not by Mist
or Magma, but by common Snow. 

I have since painted it White to provide
Camouflage in what could rightly be considered
its Natural Habitat.

ーCoppersunー
It has come Time to Cease and Desist calling my
Creation this "Thing" and give it a proper Name.

The XII, for its Part, was called the Omega Mark
XII during Development, though many such as
Myself abbreviate this to a simple XII. 

According to the Records of the Researcher who
originally named it, "Omega" was the final Letter
in an Alphabet used in ancient Times.

Therefore, I, too, borrowed from the Ancients in
naming my Creation the "Upsilon."

Because I now find Myself with two of these
Devices, I shall call the first Upsilon, and the
second Upsilon-A2.

ーGoldsunー
As part of my continuing Efforts to power my
Devices with as much Efficiency as is Possible,
I have created yet another Upsilon, this one
deriving its energies from common Sea Water.

I have painted it a stunning Marine Blue,
and named it somewhat unimaginatively,
I confess, Upsilon-A3.\end\

ーSilversunー
I have now attached Devices for the remote
Operation of all three Upsilons, and sent them to
Locations chosen for a plentiful Supply of the
Materials used by my Upsilons for their Growth.
Now begin the Tests.

An Incident befalls my Project.

A3 was sent to the Sea, whereupon it proceeded
to Run Wild and Explode in a rather exaggerated
Manner. I have narrowed down the Cause to an
over-Intake of Material, exceeding the Capacity
of the Growth Function.

ーAshleafー
My "Superiors" have begun work on a Mage
Cannon using for its Source of Power nothing
other than Mist. It is yet another Affront to my
Work. Upsilon will remind Them of their proper
Place.

ーMistleafー
I have attached a Sensor to A1 able to detect
the Mage Cannon in Operation. As soon as they
have found Success, A1 will destroy their Facility.
Only then will all be Well.

Anticipating the eventual Destruction of A1, I
have Installed a Self-Activation System into A2.
Should A1 fail, A2 will automatically wake from its
Watching and destroy the Target in its Brother's
stead.

ーEmberleafー
I have placed A1 and A2 in the Location where
they last tested their Mage Cannon. Now I only
need wait for the Destruction to come.

(The remainder of the document is charred
beyond legibility.)\end\

Where else can you meet all variety of creatures
with no consequences but Grann's Menagerie?
So went the literature, but recently a spate of
escapes from the park has raised concerns for
visitor safety.

Fears continue to mount, with a significant
proportion of the park's escapees having run
riot, to the very great detriment of several
properties in the area.

Park head Mr. Grann has acknowledged the facts
of the situation, citing abnormal stress on the
monsters as a contributing factor to the rise in
escapes.

Probable causes of stress include any extremity
of treatment, such as abandonment or, still worse,
the administration of excessive affection.
Park workers and the Grann family have been
sternly cautioned by the Society for the
Protection of Monsters.\end\

liberate one of those ancient swords lodged
in the preternaturally hard shell of a blade
biter...until now!

The sword was immediately offered to renowned
metallurgist Mr. Steeling, yet the strength of

Thanks for the kupoppies the other day.
I made the tincture and swallowed it down just
before reaching Fluorgis, and lo and behold,
I was talking just like her in moments.

It's still unclear to me precisely what
quality of her speech is supposed by some
to differentiate her as "special" and "grown-up,"
however... Evidently, the same can be said of
her, as she severed all ties with me the moment
I opened my mouth.

It's not your fault, really. The blame is mine
for relying on such a crutch. I merely thought to
relay to you the outcome of things with this
letter, kupo.

...Kupo!?

Finally! The tincture's worn off! I'm back to
normal...and maybe it's for the best.

Maybe she'll think so too! I'm off to try again!
Wish me luck, kupo!
 Kolulu\end\

Thanks so much for the cactus fruit the other
day.

The medicine worked, and the boy was brought
back from death's doorstep and restored to full
health.

Much to my surprise, the boy hailed from a
wealthy family, and they were quite generous
in showing me their gratitude.

Though this was truly unexpected, I've resolved
to make the most of it by traveling to Moorabella,
there to refine my skills in magickal medicine.

medicines and applications, has been recognized
by the Ivalice Herbalists Association for his
contributions.

Mr. Ocktor has developed tinctures for treating
the most intractable ailments, worked in several
areas of medicine, and through his innovations,
saved many lives.

Rumors have now surfaced that the Rozarrian
Imperial League of Physicians, located in the

I thank you for your watchful eyes and strong
arms in Targ Wood. I owe my life to your dutiful
protection!

Still, the whole affair came as quite a shock.

I've given this a great deal of thought, and I've
decided to put off going to Rozarria, and quit my
research laboratory in Moorabella. It's really the
only option.
 Mack Ocktor\end\

Thank you so much for getting me my cake back
the other day.

On my father's birthday, I summoned up what
courage I had and, bringing him my homemade
carrot cake, I spoke to him at last.

I was...shy at first. But as we talked, it became
easier until I could hardly remember that we
had been fighting.

It seems strange to me now that we ever had a
falling out. Why was I fighting with my father,
anyway?

Was it because he ate all my favorite malboro
jelly?

Or maybe because he left the corral door open
one day when I had told him time and time again
to be careful, and my favorite chocobo got away?

...Well, all that's past us now, isn't it?
And I have you to thank.

Thank you, thank you so much!
 Lea\end\

Nestled in the Rupie Mountains lie two villages,
at odds with each other for many years. One is
inhabited by the scaled bangaa, the other by the
shaggy mountain nu mou. The villages are rivals in
all things.

Nowhere is their rivalry more raw than in the
battle between the villages' elite clans: the
Bangaa Brotherhood, and the Nu Mou Nobles.

This battle, fought in fits and starts over years,
has come to be known as the Rivalry of the
Rupies, and many visitors to Jylland travel to the
mountains just to witness it.\end\

Word is that the Bangaa Brotherhood and Nu Mou
Nobles are at it again up in the Rupie Mountains!

Perhaps rumors of a growing desire to end the
conflict once and for all are true, for both sides
have been openly recruiting mercenaries in the
pubs of late.\end\

A word in your ear: that trade magnate over
in Moorabella, Lord Parkay, is planning
something big up in the Rupie Mountains.

Now, the Rupie Mountains are known for their
natural beauty...but the terrain can be harsh on
the traveler. That's what Parkay wants to fix.
He wants to turn the place into some kind of
family resort!

The lord is already in negotiations with local
residents, buying up parcels of land...and word is
he plans to send in clans to deal with them what
don't want to sell...

But you didn't hear -that- from me.
 ーDomis Streetears\end\

Just the other day, it finally happened.

The Bangaa Brotherhood and the Nu Mou Nobles
agreed on terms of peace, and the Rivalry of the
Rupies is finally over!

The two clans plan to devote themselves to the
protection of the Rupie Mountains.

Though the events that started the Rivalry of
the Rupies are shrouded in mystery, few want
to pry too deeply, for fear of reopening old
wounds that might prompt a return to hostilities.\end\

It's me! Kuleek from the Akademy?
Thanks for the help with that love philtre!

Actually...the experiment was a failure.

It turns out someone had told her about
how I'd sat with her when she was in the
grip of the fever...and that's why she
fell in love with me!

It had nothing to do with the philtre at all!
Failure has never tasted so sweet!\end\

The crushatrice is known for its especially violent
temperament, but one in particular makes all the
rest look like docile hens.

Adventurers in the know call it Klesta, and its
name evokes fear deep in the cockles of their
hearts.

Klesta is mean, real mean. It attacks people,
animals, anything that gets in its way.

Surely, someone would have dealt with this
scourge a long time ago, were it not so
nefariously resilient.

Many are the hunters who claim to have taken
the beast to death's door only to have it escape
at the last moment, only to return a day or two
later fully restored to health!

And those hunters were the best of the best.
The rest that tried to take on this fell beast,
well...it's still alive, isn't it.\end\

What other elite group of headhunters would do
anythingーprovided there's gil on the tableーbut
House Bowen?

What other clan has brought in more than four
hundred marks? That alone would qualify them
as one of Ivalice's top-tier teamsーand that's not
even taking into account the high demand for
their services as escorts for important personages,
sellswords for padding out forces during regional
conflicts, and gods-know-what goings-on taking
place behind drawn curtains.

Their leader, Bowen, is not only
a fearsome combatant, but a cool-headed thinker
as well, who takes on even the smallest request
with the utmost care and caution.

Yet Bowen is also known as someone who
would lay down his life to save a comrade. The
fervent loyalty this inspires is one of the secrets
to House Bowen's success.\end\

It's been several years now since the lady
headhunter Friese made her name known among
the clans.

Slayer of countless marks, the beauty with
which she worked her sword-edge earned her
the title of Blademaiden Frieseーand a
position of honor next to Blademaster Frimelda as
one of Jylland's most celebrated women warriors.

While little is known about Friese the woman, it is
true she often traveled with several companions,
making it likely she was a member of a clan.

In her heyday, new tales of her derring-do
sprang up in the taverns with every new moon,
but of late, the bards sing little of her conquests.
Even the streetears have stopped whispering
her name.

One wonders what she is doing now, and where.\end\

Know you the mage clan Cinquleur?

Oh, they're a rare lot: arrogant, heavy-handed,
wanting nothing more than to find the strong...
and fight them.

That said, they bite with as much ferocity as
they bark.

Quite a few clans snapped and took their
challenge, only to be reduced to sobbing,
defeated losers on the tourney field...

You ask me, I'd steer well clear of them.
Unless, of course, you're sure you can win.
 ーDomis Streetears\end\

ーCarm Mercantile House Reportー

We're a youthful house, in operation for what
some might consider a scant twenty years since
our beginnings wrighting ships in the port town
of Graszton.

Yet, our youthfulness has been our strength. We
have honed our techniques, built up an impressive
list of clients and successes, and since our entry
into the comestible freight business ten years
past, our support has grown among all the people
of the regions we serve, making us one of the
largest mercantile houses in all Jylland.

We look forward to continuing to support the
growth and prosperity of Jylland as we expand
our operations to accommodate future demand.

ーNOTICEー
To commemorate our first twenty years, we have
started a new branch of House operations
dedicated to a recently growing concern:
the protection and preservation of endangered
monsters.*

We will be releasing a report on our progress
shortly.

*Endangered monster: Any monster that, due to
its being a source of valuable or otherwise
efficacious materials, has been hunted to the
brink of extinction.

While monsters were previously considered to
exist for the sole purpose of felling, it has
become clear that the removal of certain monsters
from their habitat has caused irreversible damage
to the food chain, resulting in considerably
weakened ecological systems. Hence, the need for
their preservation.\end\

ーThe Jylland Free Press: Special Issueー

Graszton Mega-House Carm Mercantile's Big-Time
Blunder!

Only recently, Carm Mercantile began their
campaign to preserve endangered monsters,
which has apparently fueled interest in hunting
one rare breed!

The name of this endangered monster is the
cluckatrice: a white-feathered, red-wattled bird
creature.

As it so happens, the flavorsome, nutritious flesh
of this bird has made it widely popular, and the
meat now fetches a handsome price at market.

The adult cluckatrice's larger-than-hume size made
it even more of an attractive target among those
in the know, as one full-grown bird could supply a
sizeable quantity of meat. Further publicity on the
birds as a result of Carm Mercantile's misguided
efforts only served to raise public awareness of
the creatures, and hunting is now at a fever
pitch.

Soon after the monster preservation campaign
began, suspicious characters began popping up, 
looking for cluckatrices wherever they might
roamーa clear sign that something was amiss.
While the poachers certainly bear ultimate
responsibility for their immoral deeds, Carm
Mercantile must also bear blame for not having
foreseen this rather morbid turn of events.
 Anrias, Reporter of the Truth\end\

ーThe Jylland Free Press: Special Issueー

Graszton Mega-House Carm Mercantile:
An Ongoing Saga of Shame!

We recently looked into Carm Mercantile's
ill-considered campaign to protect endangered
monsters.

Carm Mercantile have admitted that poaching
continues unabated, but have expressed hope
that this is a temporary state of affairs
prompted by the spread of the story.
"We at Carm Mercantile would like to stress
that the purpose of our campaign was to raise
awareness of the plight of endangered monsters,
certainly not to encourage their further
endangering," a House Carm spokesperson stated
late last week.

If nothing else, this campaign and resulting
story certainly has raised awareness of
endangered monsters. Though whether this
will ultimately be to the monsters' betterment
or detriment is a matter for time to tell.
 Anrias, Reporter of the Truth\end\

ーThe Jylland Free Press: Special Issueー

Graszton Mega-House Carm Mercantile:
The Shameful Saga Continues!

News flash! A mysterious group is behind the
recent poaching of endangered monsters!

This reporter, having spotted a clan capturing
endangered monsters in the Galerria Deep,
followed the poachers only to witness them
passing their catch off to a mysterious group
of traders in the pre-dawn light of the Bisga
Greenlands in exchange for a sizeable quantity
of gil.

This reporter would have inquired further as to
the identity of the traders, but the palpable
whiff of danger that came wafting from them
would have discouraged a berserker with a
death wish.
No everyday monster traffickers, these!

Though this reporter did not see what transpired
next, it is safe to say that this confirms the
presence of at least one organization paying
good gil for the endangered monsters, made
popular by Carm Mercantile's preservation
campaign.

As a reporter of the truth, I, Anrias, vow to get
to the bottom of these shady dealings, and
expose the identity of these traders in
contraband once and for all!
 Anrias, Reporter of the Truth\end\

ーThe Jylland Free Press: Special Issueー

Shady Group Behind Poaching of Endangered 
Monsters: Our Investigation Continues!

My continuing inquiry into the group behind the
poaching of endangered monsters has revealed a
stunning truth!

It turns out there's more to the endangered
monster in question, the cluckatrice, than we
previously suspected!

Apparently, the cluckatrice's wild demeanor when
angered made it perfectly suited for cock
fighting...a sport which the mysterious group or
should I say "syndicate" behind the cluckatrices'
capture has been promoting in secret!

Fans come to see the games, and the syndicate
reaps the profits from the betting booths.

Even more surprising is the clientele at these illicit
bouts. Not only do upstanding gentlemen knights
of Graszton and the nobles of Moorabella attend,
but crowds have come from the merchant families
of Eastern Jylland, and there have even been
sightings of ambassadors from the far and distant
empire of Rozarria in attendance.

I cannot hide my abject amazement that there
exists, today, an organization capable of carrying
out such a large-scale underground gambling
operation.

I would like to continue my reportage and uncover
the true face of this shadowy organization, but
now that the case is under the jurisdiction of the
Jylland Defenders of the Peace, I, along with
my faithful readers, can but await their
announcement.

So, in lieu of more truth-finding and
truth-revealing, I will leave you with a thought.

"Khamja, Khamja makes a brave boy weep,
cry too much and they'll come while you sleep."

What child of our generation did not grow up
knowing this rhyme? Yet few know that know
that Khamja was in fact a crime syndicate
that terrorized our land more than a hundred
years ago.

I believe it is no exaggeration to say that the
group behind this recent spate of criminal
activities is no less a threat to our way of life
than Khamja was in our ancestors' day. Gods
protect us all!
 Anrias, Reporter of the Truth, signing off.\end\

A workshop located in the Aldanna Range, where
Mastersmith Chita and his apprentices toil daily
to produce new weapons to arm our stalwart
knights.

Chita's booming voice. When asked, one apprentice

The Jylland Geological Survey Committee has
released the findings of their most recent survey.

According to the committee's report, new evidence
has been found supporting a theory behind the
increasing numbers of unusually aggressive
monsters.

of a poisonous substance found in several of the
areas surveyed.

The substance is said to smell something like
chocobo talons, a scent that becomes stronger
at higher concentrations.

Monsters exposed to the scent exhibit signs of
mental instability, suffering delusions and 
periods of rampant, uncontrolled activity.

rocks bearing amounts of this substance have
been used for stonework which, beautiful though it
is, has the unfortunate disadvantage of being
mildly poisonous to people.

The survey committee has begun a campaign to
inform mines and stonecrafting workshops in the
areas where this substance is found, as well as
calling for increased caution when working
potentially tainted materials.\var2:00\\end\

The history of Judges and the law began several
hundred years ago here, in Jylland.

There is a place in Jylland called the Wellspring
of Magick, and it is this source of power that
feeds the near immortal magickal constructs we
call Judges.

While the Judges and their laws hold sway over
all Jylland, it is the way of this magick that,
for one to benefit from its effects, one must
swear an oath to the Judges to uphold their laws.

It is thought this is intended to prevent misuse
of the Judges, and is at all times an entirely
voluntary oath. Only those who desire its benefits
need swear.

As we can see, there is nothing in the structure
of laws that cannot be explained by our modern
theory of magick.\end\

That the existence of Judges is unique to Jylland
can be ascertained by looking at both their role
and their roots.

A Judge is a magickal creatureーa golem, if you
willーmade solely for the purpose of forming
contracts of law.

The Judges and their laws were first conceived
hundreds of years ago, by the court mages of
Archduke Beaudonis who then ruled all of western
Jylland.

His goals were nothing less than the adjudication
of war. With the Judges in direct control of 
combat, profitless battles could be avoided, and
peace preserved.

However, the people of his day rebelled against
the strong arm of the Judges' law, until it was
decided that the Judges' laws would be upheld and
their benefits received only by those who wished
to swear the Judge-oathーand so it remains
to this day.\end\

There are worlds within our world of Ivalice that
we cannot touch or know as we know our own
bed, home, or town.

The Netherworld, the Empyreal Plain, the World of
Illusion...these are together known as otherworlds,
unseen by eye; untouched by hand.

The order of creatures known as scions hails from
these otherworlds. They are found in many places,
in many lands, and they count among their number
emissaries of the gods, protector spirits,
and even great doers of evil.

Though the otherworlds are not normally
accessible from Ivalice, if certain requirements
are met, it is possible to give otherworldly
power a physical manifestation in our world. This
is most commonly seen in the pact made by the
summoner who calls down an Esper to fight for
them.

From the legend of a great mage in the far
eastern realms who sundered a magickal seal,
thus receiving a scion as a servant, it would
seem that they, too, operate by these same
principles.

In Jylland, it has been discovered that the
summoning of scions is possible with the use of
a particular magickal device. However, it is certain
that the power manifested through this means is
only an echo of the scion's true power. To evoke
the true power of a scion, it would be necessary
to harmonize oneself to the scion's being, fusing
not only one's purpose with the scion, but one's
own body and mind.\end\

We often hear stories of such-and-such grimoire,
but in truth, any and all books of magick can
rightly claim the name "grimoire."

Say, for instance, the tome a young mage might
consult to learn the intricacies of casting the
magick "fire." This, too, is a grimoire.

So we see, grimoires are everywhere. A part of
daily life in this Ivalice. So prevalent have they
become, we cease to call them by their proper
name, and instead treat them much as we might
treat a manual for cooking mushrooms, or a
book of fanciful illustrations for children.

...Yet there exists a magickal tome to which
the name of grimoire still rightfully, nay,
unquestionably belongs.\end\

The ultimate book of magickーThe Gran Grimoire. 

Who crafted it, and when? This is not known to
us. We do not even know if the Gran Grimoire is
a single weighty tome, or a roomful of such tomes.
Either is equally possible.

According to writings on the Gran Grimoire, he
who possesses this book has power enough to
shape the very fabric of the world. Yet, with
the mere existence of the book now passed
into legend, the truth can no longer be known.\end\

What one must not forget is, while Prima Donna
have seen such success on the stage, and clearly
take their performances very seriously, they also
operate as a fully fledged clan, and boast
accomplishments in this theatre which are no
less impressive.

But this tribute to their enchanting qualities falls
short of the real thing. How can cold words on a
page compare to the majesty that is Prima Donna?
I only hope I have given my readers enough
cause to investigate this phenomenon themselves,
perhaps at a local stage near you.

better served warm.\var2:00\\end\

cut open, however, it is a lush, slightly
sweet treat for the palate.\var2:00\\end\

known to brighten during spells of cold weather.\var2:00\\end\

metal.\var2:00\\end\

This purple pollen is extremely poisonous.

removing much of its scent. Used as a material

of these handy.\var2:00\\end\

beasts with a natural aversion to the shape.\var2:00\\end\

This moss grows naturally into a fuzzy green
ball shape. Staring at it gives you a fuzzy
warm feeling.\var2:00\\end\

A variety of lightmoss that grows in damp places.

Eating too many of these stalks induces a
kind of ennui.\var2:00\\end\

A green leaf that gives off a refreshing scent.

easy to carve, this is the ideal material for

a very fine grain.\var2:00\\end\

fashioning magickal wands and other trappings

popular for use in campfires.\var2:00\\end\

impregnated with tar, making it highly resistant

This lumber has a slightly reddish gleam to it.

The narrow grain of this wood makes it ideal for
whittling, and popular with carpenters.\var2:00\\end\

made from the bark.\var2:00\\end\

This strange wood emits a wan light. Used in the
making of magickal artifacts.\var2:00\\end\

years in home building.\var2:00\\end\

This twig is kept as a ward against evil for its

This wood was thought to have come from a tree

stench that assaults the nostrils.\var2:00\\end\

This yellowish liquid bubbles and foams. Its color

automatically when someone else does something to
you.

know everything just yet. Let me give you a few
pointers to see you stay in one piece.

First is mimics. Who isn't taken in by the promise
of untold riches that magicked urn or chest might
hold? Well, mimics take advantage of that desire
for all things golden, springing out to take eager
adventurers unawares. So don't go pokin' around
unless you're ready for a fight.

Second is traps. Without a keen eye and the
proper skill, you won't know where they are until
it's too late. But with the right preparation you
can avoid traps, and even use them to your
advantage by luring enemies into them.

Third, if you have trouble remembering the first
two and worst comes to worst, you can always use

feet.

Afflictions and Ailments

There are a great number of debilitating magicks
at the mage's disposal. Learning their various
effects is the first step toward mastering them.

KO
  The victim is unconscious and can neither move
  nor act.
Stone
  The victim has been turned to solid stone and
  can neither move nor act.
Toad
  The victim has been turned into a toad and can
  only move.
Berserk
  The victim loses all control and mindlessly strikes
  out at his foes.
Charm
  The victim mistakes friend for foe, attacking his
  allies.
Confuse
  The victim acts erratically, attacking friend and
  foe alike.
Poison
  Poison courses through the victim's body, slowly
  depleting his health.
Blind
  The victim cannot see and has difficulty landing
  physical attacks.
Silence
  The victim cannot speak, preventing the use of
  magick.
Sleep
  The victim is in a magicked sleep and can neither
  move nor act.
Immobilize
  The victim cannot move.
Disable
  The victim cannot act.
Addle
  The victim forgets all knowledge of abilities.
Slow
  The flow of time is slowed for the victim,
  increasing the delay between actions.
Stop
  The flow of time is stopped for the victim,
  preventing him from moving or acting.
Oil
  A flammable oil covers the victim, rendering him
  vulnerable to fire-based attacks.

  ーThe Forgetful Mage, Excerpt\end\

The Lesser Undead

The dark hills and woods of the land abound
with all manner of undead fiend. Zombies and
ghosts are two of the more common, if not
more deadly, variety.

Both zombie and ghost are possessed of the
ability to rise after being struck down, but only
ghosts can teleport where they will, attacking
their quarry from all sides.

Cunning and luck are needed in equal measure
to defeat a group of the creatures, as they
must all be defeated at the same time in order
that rites might be performed to prevent their
rising again.

Those with knowledge of burial might inter a
corpse during battle, and placing a phoenix down
on the remains will likewise release the spirit to
eternal rest.

All would be wise to employ curative magicks and
the holy healing powers of potions and the like
when facing these minions of the dark.
  ーBestiary of Creatures Fantastic and Rare\end\

Uff, das Abenteurerdasein kann auch
ganz schön anstrengend sein. Eine
Verschnaufpause täte sicher gut.\var2:00\\end\

Ahh, das hat gutgetan!
Jetzt kann's weitergehen!\var2:00\\end\

Ich brauch ...
\defaultOption:20\... 'ne kleine Auszeit.\endOption\... meine Sommerferien.\endOption\... Sonderurlaub!\endOption\... nichts. Weiter geht's!\endOption\\end\

Endlich Sommerferien!\endPage\\end\Dass unser Lehrer zum Ende aber auch immer so
lange Reden halten muss ...\var2:00\\end\

Wir haben alle ein Tagebuch bekommen, das wir

Es ist schon lästig. Aber welche Hausaufgaben sind
das nicht ...\endPage\\end\Ich will auf keinen Fall wieder schreiben müssen:
„Meine Tante hat mir eine Strafpredigt gehalten."\endPage\\end\Dabei hatte ich wie immer nur die besten Absichten ...\var2:00\\end\

Na bitte! Sieht doch gut aus.
Das werden bestimmt meine schönsten Sommerferien!\var2:00\\end\

Eigentlich weiß ich es ja noch gar nicht.
Aber gerade deswegen freue ich mich auf die Ferien!\var2:00\\end\

Was mich dieses Jahr in den Sommerferien wohl

Ihnen begegnet man in Ivalice

seitig begabt und begeistern
sich sowohl für Krieger- als

Sie sind entfernte Nachfahren der
Reptilien. Ihr schuppiger Körper
ist robust und behände zugleich.
Ihr aufbrausendes Gemüt und ihre
Kämpfernatur kommen vor allem
in Krieger-Berufen zur Geltung.\var2:00\\end\

Ihr treuer Blick und die langen
Schlappohren erinnern an Hunde.
Ihr enormes Wissen befähigt sie
zu starken Magieangriffen. Sie
sind nicht sehr kräftig und
kämpfen daher nur ungern.\var2:00\\end\

Sie bevölkern die Wälder und
tragen langes, silbern glänzendes
Haar. Sie rühmen sich eleganter
Grazie sowie hoher Schnelligkeit.
Trotz ihrer zierlichen Figur
landen sie schwere Treffer.\var2:00\\end\

Ein großer Bommel am Kopf sowie
Fledermausflügel auf dem Rücken
zeichnen diese kleinen Wesen aus.
Sie mögen Überraschungen und
originelle Berufe, in denen sie ihre
Fingerfertigkeit beweisen können.\var2:00\\end\

Sie sehen aus wie Schweine, sind
recht beleibt und haben kurze
Füße. Sie agieren viel schneller,
als man erwarten würde, obgleich
ihre Kampfkünste jeglicher
Intelligenz und Moral entbehren.\var2:00\\end\

Diese Flügelwesen besitzen neben
Drachenschwingen auch einen
kräftigen Schwanz. Sie gelten als
hartnäckig und ungestüm. Ihr
kleiner und schöner Körper wird
dabei zu einer gefährlichen Waffe.\var2:00\\end\

Auf der Landkarte kann man sich zwischen einzelnen
Wegpunkten frei bewegen.\endPage\\end\Eine blauer Luftballon über einem Wegpunkt markiert
diesen Ort als nächstes Ziel.\endPage\\end\Begib dich als Erstes ins Dorf am Rande des Waldes,
wo sogleich auf der Karte ein Ballon erscheint.\var2:00\\end\

In jeder Stadt gibt es verschiedene Orte, die man
aufsuchen kann.\endPage\\end\Mit \sprite:04\ öffnet man dazu ein entsprechendes Menü.\endPage\\end\Geh nun in die Taverne und nimm deine erste

\varA:00\ Clemens!\endPage\\end\Deine Sommerferien fangen
dieses Jahr etwas später an.\endPage\\end\Du verlässt diesen Raum nicht in

Soll ich Ihnen vielleicht ein Buch
besorgen?\var2:00\\end\

Wie oft bist du in diesem Schuljahr zu
spät gekommen?\endPage\\end\Wie oft hast du deine Hausaufgaben
vergessen oder den Unterricht ge-
stört?\var2:00\\end\

Ich kann es dir auch nicht genau sa-
gen. Irgendwann war im Klassenbuch
nämlich kein Platz mehr für Einträge!\endPage\\end\Hör mal, du bist ganz sicher kein
schlechter Schüler.\endPage\\end\Dennoch bin ich der Meinung, dass du
eine besondere Lektion verdienst!\var2:00\\end\

Ich gebe dir jetzt die Gelegenheit,
tief in dich zu gehen und über das
letzte Schuljahr nachzudenken.\endPage\\end\Und wo ließen sich solche Gedanken
besser fassen als in der Bibliothek
beim Aufräumen!\var2:00\\end\

Glaub mir, die Bibliothek ist genau

Hand gebrauchen.\var2:00\\end\

Und denk nicht, dass du durch den
Hintereingang verschwinden kannst.\endPage\\end\Sonst muss ich nämlich in den Ferien

Ja, ist ja gut ...\endPage\\end\Auf Wiedersehen! Ihnen auch schöne

Nanu, Herr Randell ist ja gar nicht da!\var2:00\\end\

So eine alte Schwarte gehört doch ins
Museum!\var2:00\\end\

Was ist das überhaupt für ein Buch?
Lauter Schwerter, Monster, Zauberer!\var2:00\\end\

Mm?\endPage\\end\Der Text hört ein-
fach mittendrin auf!\var2:00\\end\

Was hat das zu bedeuten? Bis zur
letzten Seite alles weiß!\endPage\\end\Moment! Hier steht was geschrieben:

Das klingt eindeutig nach einer weite-
ren Gelegenheit, mich mit meinem Au-
togramm zu verewigen, hehe.\var2:00\\end\

Der kühne Knabe, der es

Du meine Güte! Das ist vielleicht 'n
dickes Ei!\var2:00\\end\

Unsereiner will nur seinen Gilbeutel
etwas aufbessern und dann steht so

gen", aber 250 Piepen für diesen Ko-
loss scheinen mir etwas zu mager.\var2:00\\end\

Du hast doch nicht etwa Hunger,

dir dein Fresschen woanders!\var2:00\\end\

Uwahhh!
Die sehen auch nicht
grad aus wie Menschen!\var2:00\\end\

Nun mal ganz ruhig, ja? Wir helfen dir!\endPage\\end\Wenn du diesen Ort lebend verlassen
willst, rate ich dir, schnell unserem
Clan beizutreten!\var2:00\\end\

Unserem Clan. Als Mitglied überlebst du
auch die schwersten Verletzungen!\var2:00\\end\

Was ist denn nun? ... Oder willst du
dich lieber mit Gevatter Gockel hier
anfreunden?\var2:00\\end\
In Ordnung! Sag mir, was ich tun soll.\var2:00\\end\

Du musst den Richterschwur leisten!
„Ich schließe mich dem Clan an!"\var2:00\\end\

Du hast es erfasst, mein Freund.
Und nun keine Zeit vertrödelt! Dem
Goldgeflügel läuft schon der Geifer!\var2:00\\end\
Richter! Ich schwöre.\endPage\\end\Ich schließe mich dem Clan an!\var2:00\\end\

Na, das nenne ich eine anständige
Garderobe! Fantastisch!\var2:00\\end\

So schnell kann's gehen und du hast

He, Kleiner, keine Bange!
Wir haben alles im Griff!
Überlass uns die Sache!\var2:00\\end\

Ihr wollt die allen Ernstes
plattmachen?\var2:00\\end\

Das wird sicher kein Zuckerschlecken,
Kleiner! Bleib lieber auf Abstand!\var2:00\\end\

Lasst mich auch mitmachen! Ich habe
doch den Richterschwur geleistet. Ich

Was?

aber glaub mir, du kriegst ordentlich

Wir haben dich aber auch nicht als

Versprichst du mir, dass du genau das
tun wirst, was ich dir sage?\var2:00\\end\

Wie heißt du?\var2:00\\end\

Also dann, \varA:00\.
Knöpfen wir uns die Bande vor!\var2:00\\end\

Heute scheint noch mein Glückstag zu

Das können wir alles nachher klären.

Oh ... Habt ihr eigentlich schon ...?

gegessen ...\var2:00\\end\

Haha. Du bist mir ein Held! Willst
hungrigen Monstern das Maul stopfen

'nen Happen essen. Danach können wir
in aller Ruhe quatschen.\var2:00\\end\

Wenn du gegen Monster kämpfst,
solltest du einige Sachen beachten.\endPage\\end\Ich will dir kurz die wichtigsten
Punkte erklären.\var2:00\\end\

Während eines Kampfes hängt es von
deiner Geschwindigkeit ab, wann du an
die Reihe kommst.\endPage\\end\Dass ich als erste dran bin, heißt also
nichts anderes, als dass ich von allen
die höchste Geschwindigkeit habe.\var2:00\\end\

nichts, solange du ein Monster nur aus
der Ferne siehst ...\var2:00\\end\

Aktion ausführst, bist du umso
schneller wieder an der Reihe.\var2:00\\end\

bedenken:\endPage\\end\Es hängt von deinem Beruf und von
deiner Rasse ab, wie viele Schritte

Lass die Einheit ein paar Schritte gehen, indem du
den Befehl „Bewegen" verwendest!\var2:00\\end\

Ich werde dir einen Schnellkurs geben,
wie du Aktionen ausführst.\var2:00\\end\

Angriffe aus.\endPage\\end\Entweder kämpfst du mit einer aus-

setzen.\endPage\\end\Lass uns einmal versuchen, die
Fertigkeit „Feuer" zu benutzen.\var2:00\\end\

Magie ist ein äußerst effektives
Angriffsmittel. Jeder Einsatz
kostet dich allerdings MP.\endPage\\end\Der MP-Wert füllt sich mit jeder
Runde wieder etwas auf. Trotzdem
solltest du keine MP verschwenden.\var2:00\\end\

aufgelistet.\endPage\\end\Bewege die Einheit nun in die Nähe von Cresat und
führe mit „Feuer" einen Angriff aus!\var2:00\\end\

So, \varA:00\, jetzt bin ich
an der Reihe. Für diesmal ent-
scheide ich selber, was ich tue.\var2:00\\end\

Ich kämpfe als „Gast" an deiner Seite
und du kannst mir keine Befehle er-
teilen.\endPage\\end\Trotzdem bleiben wir natürlich
Freunde! Ich werde ziemlich sauer,
wenn du aus Versehen mich angreifst!\var2:00\\end\

Wenn einer der Gefährten an der Reihe ist und man
\sprite:05\ drückt, wird der Zeiger frei beweglich.\endPage\\end\Jetzt lässt sich jede beliebige Einheit mit dem Zeiger
anwählen und ihr genauer Status mit „Einheiteninfo"
abfragen.\endPage\\end\Nun ist die Reihe an \varA:00\. Verwende
„Bewegen" und „Aktionen" und bezwinge Cresta!\var2:00\\end\

Als du deinen Namen hineingeschrieben
hast, hat das Buch aufgeleuchtet und
danach standest du im Wald ...?!\var2:00\\end\

Ich hab mich vielleicht erschreckt!
Um mich herum alles grün und dann
noch dieses fette Monstertier.\endPage\\end\Und du bist ja auch kein Mensch ...
Ach nein, wie sagt man hier ... Hume.\endPage\\end\Ich hab wirklich nicht gewusst,
wach ich oder träum ich.\var2:00\\end\

Du scheinst mir aber mit jeder
Situation fertigzuwerden. Bist
halt 'n kleiner Draufgänger ...\endPage\\end\Da wir das geklärt haben,
können wir nun alle kräf-
tig reinhauen!\var2:00\\end\

Nein, nein. Ich muss unbedingt Gewiss-
heit haben.\endPage\\end\Mir knurrt auch der Magen. Aber ich
kriege keinen Bissen runter, bevor
ich nicht weiß ...\var2:00\\end\

Ist ja schon gut! Da ist wohl der Ma-
gen mit mir durchgegangen, wie? Tut
mir echt leid.\endPage\\end\Um also deine Frage zu beantworten ...
Du befindest dich hier in Ivalice.\endPage\\end\Du hast in dem Buch geblättert, und im
nächsten Augenblick hat's dich aus dei-
ner Welt in diese hier verschlagen.\var2:00\\end\

Das klingt alles ziemlich beunruhigend,
wenn du mich fragst.\endPage\\end\Wer weiß, ob ich jemals wieder zurück
nach Hause komme ...\endPage\\end\Meine Tante macht sich sicher schon
Sorgen, wo ich denn bleibe. Ich muss
unbedingt einen Weg zurück finden!\var2:00\\end\

Hey, du hast uns getroffen! Das war
schon dein erster Schritt in Richtung
Heimat. Wir werden dir helfen!\var2:00\\end\

Na klar. Als wir dich in unseren Clan
aufgenommen haben, hab ich so was
in der Art schon kommen sehen ...\var2:00\\end\

Oh danke, Cid!\endPage\\end\Bis ich einen Weg zurück
gefunden habe, werde ich

doch schon ganz gut ge-
macht. Findest du nicht?\var2:00\\end\

Wenn ich mir überlege, was ich hier

Ich bin \varA:00\.
Ich werde für einige
Zeit in eurem Clan ...\var2:00\\end\

Sag mal, Cid. Euer Clan hat doch

Unser Clan heißt \varA:01\.\endPage\\end\Der Name hat sich noch nicht

Nun gut, also dann noch mal in aller

heute ein offizielles
Mitglied bei \varA:01\.\endPage\\end\Ich weiß, dass ich noch viel lernen

Heute erledigen wir keine Missionen

Hm, für heute haben wir unser Soll

Ich werde mal versuchen, was über

gehst, bin ich natürlich wieder
zur Stelle! Alles klar?\var2:00\\end\

Hey, so sehen also Chocobos aus!

mir vorgestellt hatte!\endPage\\end\Chocobos sind wirklich Riesenvögel!

Vorsicht! Wenn du allzu dicht
herantrittst, rastet so ein Tier
auch schon gern mal aus.\var2:00\\end\
Ach was, die sind doch ganz zahm ...\var2:00\\end\
Nanu, was haben sie denn auf einmal?\var2:00\\end\

Nun mal ruhig Blut!\endPage\\end\Während wir uns um die Wölfe küm-
mern, seid ihr im Stall besser aufge-
hoben. Los, Abmarsch nach Hause!\var2:00\\end\

Wir werden nicht zulassen, dass ihr
den Chocobos auch nur eine Feder
rupft!\var2:00\\end\

Na endlich! Die Wölfe sind wir ein für

Jetzt haben die Chocobos wieder ihren

oder?\var2:00\\end\

Uns bleibt nur noch, vom Auftraggeber
die Belohnung einzustreichen. Damit ist

So langsam hast du nun mitbekommen,

konzentrieren, die der Schlüssel zu
deiner Heimkehr sein könnten!\var2:00\\end\

Dieses Buch in der Bibliothek ...
Mit den unbeschriebenen Seiten
darin ...\endPage\\end\Wenn wir herausfinden könnten, was
es damit auf sich hat, wäre uns sicher
ein ganzes Stück weit geholfen.\var2:00\\end\

Sieht mir ganz nach einem Zauberbuch
aus ...\var2:00\\end\

Ich war von dem Buch anfangs nicht
sonderlich angetan.\endPage\\end\Es schien uralt zu sein, und der
Buchrücken war wie verkohlt.\endPage\\end\Ich kann mich nicht erinnern,
irgendeinen Buchtitel gelesen
zu haben.\var2:00\\end\

Wer weiß, was das für ein Buch war.
Von wann und von wem geschrieben ...\var2:00\\end\

Ein Tagebuch?
Wie kommst du denn darauf?\var2:00\\end\

Ta-Tatsächlich! Ein Notizbuch ...\endPage\\end\Ich hatte gedacht, dass es vielleicht
zum Gürtel gehört ... oder eine
Hüfttasche ist.\var2:00\\end\

Entweder kennst du dich in deiner
eigenen Westentasche nicht aus,
oder es gehört dir wirklich nicht!\var2:00\\end\

Mache ich denn den Eindruck, als
wollte ich jeden meiner Schritte
in einem Tagebuch protokollieren?\var2:00\\end\
Ne, den machste beileibe nicht, Kleiner!\var2:00\\end\

Was ist? Steht da was Aufregendes
drin?\var2:00\\end\

Schau doch nur, Cid! Hier steht, wie
ich von der Bibliothek nach Ivalice
gelangt bin.\endPage\\end\Und hier, wie du mir vor kurzem
geholfen hast. Hier steht einfach
alles, was ich erlebt habe!\var2:00\\end\

führt Tagebuch?\var2:00\\end\

Cid! Das Tagebuch macht schon wieder
einen Eintrag!\var2:00\\end\

Lass mich raten! Da steht, dass wir
eben die Sache mit den Wölfen er-
ledigt haben?\var2:00\\end\

Du sagst es!\endPage\\end\Schon seltsam ... Da wo du bist, ist im-
mer was los. Ich glaube, in deiner Ge-

Vielleicht ... Nein, nein, ganz bestimmt

sind also auf der richtigen Spur.\var2:00\\end\

Es liegt doch auf der Hand, dass das
magische Tagebuch uns weiterhelfen
wird.\endPage\\end\Wenn wir Missionen annehmen, die

uns das sicherlich einen Schritt weiter!\var2:00\\end\

Also dann, nichts wie zurück ins Dorf!

verdient!\var2:00\\end\

Hm? Sag mal, \varA:00\,
schleppst du immer ein
Tagebuch mir dir rum?\var2:00\\end\

Ähm, Cid ... Was hat der Richter

Was hat er damit gemeint?\var2:00\\end\

Gesetz nicht zu brechen!\var2:00\\end\

Echt?

Das hört sich so einfach an. Ob ich es

Wenn die Zeit reif ist, wirst du

dieser Welt bestanden hast.\endPage\\end\Denn bei allem, das du hier erlebst,

Das Grimoire hat dich ausersehen.
Deinen fröhlichen Lebensmut und

Weg: Sei du selbst!\var2:00\\end\

Lasst uns schnell die nächste Taverne

Was ich Euch fragen ...
Also ... Ich ...\var2:00\\end\
Hardy, was ist denn mit dir los?\var2:00\\end\

dass ich mich auf besondere Weise von
allen anderen unterschied.\var2:00\\end\

Vor vielen Generationen war der Nehzro-Tunnel
ein Transportweg, über den lebenswichtige Güter
die Stadt Gog erreichten. Lange Stollen und
Schächte ziehen sich wie ein komplexes Muster
feiner Äderchen durch den unterseeischen
Meeresboden und enden jäh an kratergleichen
ausgehobenen Gruben. Das Unterwasserlabyrinth
wurde nie kartografiert, doch wird gemunkelt, dass
in den vergessenen Unterwassergängen Schätze
und andere Kostbarkeiten verborgen liegen. Immer
wieder tauchten waghalsige Schatzsucher in die
schwarze Untiefe des Meeres hinab und waren
nie wieder gesehen.\end\

Shuah, mein liebster Freund, wohin bloß hat es
dich verschlagen? In den eisigen Schneewehen
verloren wir uns aus den Augen. Verliere nicht
die Hoffnung, denn nichts wird mir zu teuer
sein, um dich zu finden.

- Gheydo\end\

Wahrlich schwer lastet die Bürde meines hohen
Alters auf meinen Schultern. Die Knochen eines
alten Greises sind für lange Tagesmärsche nicht
mehr stark genug, wie mir dünkt. Doch meine Ein-
sicht kommt spürbar spät, denn eine Verletzung
hindert nun meine Weiterreise.
Wohlgetan sei mir, brächte mir jemand einen
Potion, zu heilen meine Wunden. Ich vernahm,
der Clan \varA:01\ sei beseelt
von Edelmut ohne Maß. Mit Verlaub möchte ich
ihn höflichst um eine Lieferung in die unwirt-
lichen Sumpflanden bitten.

- Vermut\end\

Ich wurde Zeuge wie entsetzliche Monster in der
Nähe des Waldes von Morabera ein junges Fräu-
lein umkreisten. Zwar gedachte ich ihr zu Hilfe
zu eilen, doch verließen mich meine Kräfte und
ich sank ohnmächtig zu Boden. Als ich schließlich
wieder zu Bewusstsein kam, waren das Fräulein
und die grotesken Wesen fort. Ich hoffe innigst,
sie ist nicht zu Schaden gekommen ...\end\

Irgendwie hab ich das Gefühl, dass sich immer
mehr Monster im Tramedino-Sumpfland zusammen-
rotten. Doch wie kann das sein? Die Gegend steht
doch unter dem Schutz des Schreins. Ob etwas
die Kraft des Schreins beeinträchtigt?\end\

Ein Schrein im Tramedino-Sumpfland ehrt eine
Schutzheilige, die über das Moorland wacht und
dunklen Mächten den Einlass verwehrt. Der Sage
nach soll ein kleines Mädchen, das in einem
nahegelegenen Dorf lebte, durch die Kraft des
Heilens in der Lage gewesen sein, Dämonen und
böse Monster zu vertreiben. Ihr Name lautete
Eklipse.

Als eines Tages eine Armee von Monstern, unter
der Knute eines Dämonenlords vereint, das Dorf
zu verwüsten drohte, übertrug sie einem Stein
ihre Macht und vernichtete die Monsterbrut.
Doch einen hohen Preis zahlte sie für die
hehre Tat und sie verstarb noch am selben Tag.
Fortan beteten die Dorfbewohner jenen Stein
an, in dem sie die schützende Macht des Mäd-
chens zu spüren glauben.

- Ivalisische Geschichtsschreibung\end\

Ein schreckliches Monster wird die Stadt Gog
mit Unheil überziehen und das Verderben über
seine Bewohner bringen. Ich sehe, wie sie mit
vor Entsetzen verzerrten Antlitzen vor den
träge aber unerbittlich weiterfließenden Lava-
massen fliehen ...

Als die Dunkelheit mit jenem Dämon niederkam,
erschrak sie vor der Boshaftigkeit dessen, was
sie selbst gebar. Jenes Wesen, einst für tot ge-
glaubt, ist wiederauferstanden ...

- Prophet Heiro\end\

Von Zeit zu Zeit laufe ich den Nehzro-Tunnel
ab und freue mich über die dort gefundenen
Maschinenbauteile, die ich restaurieren und
wieder verwenden kann. So auch neulich, als
plötzlich der Boden unter mir wegbrach und
ein großes Loch freilegte. Ein Loch, das direkt
in einen Schacht führte, welcher parallel zu
dem verlief, in dem ich stand. Wer weiß,
vielleicht liegt dort der große Schatz des
Nehzro-Tunnels und wartet darauf, von mir
geborgen zu werden.\end\

Wie es scheint, sind die Probleme nun beseitigt,
so dass ich mir die Dreistigkeit erlaube, Eure
kostbare Zeit in Anspruch zu nehmen. Dürfte ich
die hochherrschaftlichen Damen und Herren in
den Targo-Wald bitten.

- A. M.\end\

Gestern erzählte mir meine Großmutter eine
Gutenachtgeschichte, vor der es mich auch jetzt
noch gruselt. Es ging um einen dunklen Turm,
der nur erscheint, wenn Mondlicht auf seine
Gemäuer fällt. Noch nie gesehene Unwesen
sollen ihn behausen und einen Schatz behüten,
der kostbarer ist als alle Schätze dieser Welt.
Auch kam ein furchtloser Ritter darin vor, der
die Stufen des Turmes erklomm, als dieser im
Schein des Mondes von Gurat aus zu
sehen war ...

- Ruma, der gerne Geschichten hört\end\

Die Geschichte geht noch weiter ...
Meine Großmutter erzählte von einem weiteren
Turm, der ebenfalls nur sichtbar wird, wenn der
Schein des Mondes ihn streichelt. Dieser Turm
soll in Aisenfeld stehen und doch der gleiche wie
der aus Gurat sein. Sonderbar, nicht wahr? Es sei
derselbe Turm, jedoch ein anderer Eingang, sprach
meine Großmutter weiter und erzählte von dem
Ritter, der nun von Aisenfeld aus den Turm zu
ersteigen versuchte ...

- Ruma, der gerne Geschichten hört\end\

Meine Großmutter setzte ihre Erzählung fort
und lobte feierlich die Heldentaten, die der
furchtlose Ritter am höchsten Punkt des Turmes
vollbrachte. Der dunkle Turm sei ihrer Erzäh-
lung nach auch vom Verbotenen Land aus zu
sehen, dort, wo die Mysth undurchdringlich
ist und weder Leben noch Tod gedeihen lässt.

- Ruma, der gerne Geschichten hört\end\

So erhielt Ritter Gaol den Segen der Götter und
zog fortan mit seinem Mogry-Kumpanen Ryn durch
die Lande. Eines nachts, als der Mond in voller
Pracht in der Schwärze des Himmels stand, kamen
sie an einen dunklen Turm. Hoch droben auf der
Turmspitze stand die Mondjungfrau und blickte
auf Ritter Gaol hernieder. Der Ritter hatte
zeit seines Lebens gehofft, eine Frau von solch
reiner Schönheit zu erblicken, wie das Antlitz
der Mondjungfrau bot. Sie war auf den Namen
Evelyn getauft.

Von ihrer Schönheit geblendet, bestieg der
Ritter die Stufen des Turms, wohlweislich der
unzähligen Gefahren, die ihm begegnen würden.

- Die Sage Ritter Gaols, Kapitel des Vollmondes\end\

Wer ist nicht manchmal entnervt von Bezeich-
nungen und Titeln, die man nach den Clan-Prü-
fungen von den Richtern verpasst bekommt?
Sicherlich, kleine Geister sind in der Lage durch
ihre gleisnerischen Titel über ihre eigenen Unzu-
länglichkeiten hinwegzutäuschen. Doch mitnich-
ten sind alle Titelträger ihren Titel wert ...
Meine Wenigkeit ist befähigt jene Titel auf
Wunsch null und nichtig zu machen. Dabei gehen
freilich die mit den Titel verbundenen Wirkungen
verloren. Überlegt Euch daher gut, ob Ihr meiner
Dienste bedürft.\end\

Jyllands.

arbeit kurzfristig eingestellten Assistenten ...\end\

Ein jylländisches frohes neues Jahr!

Wo wir Urnen und Vaasen schon mal in der
Redaktion hatten, ließ ich mich herab, einen
Töpferkurs zu besuchen. Zu meinem großen
Erstaunen stellte ich doch tatsächlich fest, dass
an mir ein Meistertöpfer verloren gegangen ist.
Binnen 24 Stunden hatte ich 'ne Matschkugel
geformt, die war so rund und füllig wie meine
Wampe! Kunst ist was Feines, jawohl!

- Bonga-Redakteur\end\

Merchandise-Artikel sein Eigen nennt, ist es kaum

Kritzelecke:
Die Existenz einer liebenswerteren Großmutter
als die meine, schließe ich schlicht aus. Als ich
noch Kind war und aus irgendeinem Grund traurig
nach Hause kam, wusste sie mich mit einem
leckeren Keks aufzumuntern. Diese großmütter-
liche Fürsorge zeichnet sie auch jetzt noch aus.
Ich möchte ihr an dieser Stelle aus tiefstem
Herzen danken. Omi, du bist die Beste!

- Bonga-Redakteur\end\

Natürliche Schätze
  Laut dem Jahresbericht gebrochener Schatz-
  sucher existiert in den Weiten Jyllands ein
  Ort, der natürliche Schätze hervorbringt. Keine
  Schätze im Sinne von Rohstoffen, sondern die
  in Schatztruhen verborgenen Schätze sind hier
  gemeint. Viel mysteriöser als diese natürlichen
  Vorkommnisse, ist die Tatsache, dass mir bis
  dato diese Gegend nicht bekannt war. Wo ich
  doch praktisch immer blank bin ...
